scenarios.name: Provider 429 Rate Limiting with Bounded Deferral
scenarios.description: Provider returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After; operation deferred without resetting token budget.
scenarios.injectedFault: Simulated RateLimitedError: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests: Retry-After 5s
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Operation marked DEFERRED; token cap and used counters remain strictly preserved.
scenarios.actualOutcome: Operation deferred cleanly; BudgetCapTokens=150000, BudgetUsedTokens=12000 intact.

scenarios.name: Timeout Post Cloud Processing & UNKNOWN_OUTCOME Reconciliation
scenarios.description: Network timeout post cloud generation preserves grant; replay reconciles without double billing.
scenarios.injectedFault: Simulated TimeoutError: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout during section generation
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Grant preserved in IN_FLIGHT; reconciled by request hash with zero double billing.

scenarios.name: Truncated / Invalid JSON Schema Rejection
scenarios.description: Generator produces truncated JSON; schema validator rejects and logs typed fatal issue.
scenarios.injectedFault: Simulated TruncatedOutputError: Truncated JSON: unexpected end of stream at byte 104
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Fatal issue recorded; zero artifact heads advanced.
scenarios.actualOutcome: Recorded FATAL issue 'issue_f03_75c4627b' (SCHEMA_VIOLATION); 0 heads advanced in reading_paper_artifact_heads.

scenarios.name: Evaluator Exception Fail-Closed Rejection
scenarios.description: Evaluator throws uncaught exception; BoundedLoopRuntime fails closed to FAIL/ERROR without PASS.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Evaluation status ERROR; runtime decision FAIL; 0 unauthorized PASS decisions.
scenarios.actualOutcome: BoundedLoopRuntime terminated with 'FAIL'; 0 PASS decisions in DB.

scenarios.name: Crash Pre Artifact Commit Fencing
scenarios.description: Process crashes before artifact row insertion; head pointer remains unadvanced.
scenarios.injectedFault: Process death before SQL INSERT into reading_paper_artifacts.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Head pointer does not advance; zero dangling pointers to missing artifacts.
scenarios.actualOutcome: Confirmed 0 head pointers in reading_paper_artifact_heads for uncommitted artifact 'art_uncommitted_23d51308'.

scenarios.name: Crash Post Commit Pre ACK Replay Safety
scenarios.description: Artifact committed but ACK lost; client replay returns existing version without duplicate insert.
scenarios.injectedFault: Network connection dropped after DB commit before client HTTP ACK.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Replay query returns existing Version=1; 0 duplicate artifact rows created.
scenarios.actualOutcome: Detected existing Version 1 with hash '8f981c11e6ce697f...'; count remained exactly 1.

scenarios.name: Crash Post Passage Accepted Resumption
scenarios.description: Worker crashes after passage accepted; resume advances straight to questions without re-generating passage.
scenarios.injectedFault: SIGKILL after passage head committed before question generation.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Accepted passage v1 preserved in head; question generator references passage directly.
scenarios.actualOutcome: Question group 'art_qgroup_b9d83dda' created referencing accepted passage 'art_passage_e039b0a6'.

scenarios.name: Mid-Generation Crash Recovery at Question 17
scenarios.description: Worker crashes after Q17 committed; resume completes Q18-Q26 with zero duplicate questions.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Resume loads 17 questions; completes to 26 questions without restarting from Q1.
scenarios.actualOutcome: Durable checkpoint loaded with 17 questions; completed to 26 questions; 0 duplicates.

scenarios.name: Stale Lease Takeover & Epoch Fencing Rejection
scenarios.description: Worker A at epoch 1 attempts write after Worker B claims epoch 2.
scenarios.injectedFault: Concurrent lease takeover incrementing epoch to 2.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Worker A write rejected with UPDATE 0 rows; active state preserved under Worker B.

scenarios.name: Asynchronous User Cancellation via CancelVersion Fence
scenarios.description: Admin cancels run while worker is mid-repair; late completion write rejected by CancelVersion fence.
scenarios.injectedFault: CancelVersion bumped during in-flight repair execution.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Late completion rejected (UPDATE 0); job remains in Cancelled state.
scenarios.actualOutcome: Fence detected cancel version bump (UPDATE 0); job remained Cancelled.

scenarios.name: Stream Disconnect and Chunk Stream Sequence Reconciliation
scenarios.description: SSE stream disconnects at chunk 3/5; client reconciles sequence without mistaking incomplete for completed.
scenarios.injectedFault: Simulated SSE transport disconnect at sequence 3.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Outbox status STREAMING at sequence 3; next expected chunk is sequence 4.
scenarios.actualOutcome: Authoritative state confirmed: 3|STREAMING; partial stream not marked COMPLETED.

scenarios.name: PostgreSQL Transient Transaction Error and Clean Rollback
scenarios.description: Database transaction aborts during mutation; rollback leaves zero partial or orphaned rows.
scenarios.injectedFault: SQL transaction error simulation with explicit ROLLBACK.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Transaction rolled back cleanly; zero orphaned rows remain in PostgreSQL.
scenarios.actualOutcome: Confirmed 0 orphaned records for ID a28bf44f-c8f7-40e3-a805-f5ce5443b7fb after rollback.

scenarios.name: Source Document Replacement Dependency Closure Invalidation
scenarios.description: Source document is replaced; dependency graph invalidates exact downstream closure.
scenarios.injectedFault: Source PMC document replaced with new version.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Downstream artifacts identified and flagged for re-generation; stale reuse forbidden.
scenarios.actualOutcome: Dependency tracker identified downstream 'art_downstream_5b488720' dependent on old source 'art_src_old_ce75afbc'.

scenarios.name: Deployment Version Change & In-Flight Engine Pinning
scenarios.description: Global deployment updates engine to 2.0.0; in-flight run remains strictly pinned to 1.0.0.
scenarios.injectedFault: Global configuration upgrade while run is executing.
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Run executes with pinned EngineVersion=1.0.0; zero config contamination.
scenarios.actualOutcome: Authoritative EngineVersion verified as '1.0.0' for in-flight run 'run_f14_4d10133e'.
